intro: You have climbed eleven hundred metres above the Köprülü canyon. Welcome to Selge, a Pisidian city in Antalya province from the 5th century BC. Its theatre, built for ten thousand, still stands in the middle of a village.
history: The Pisidian city was built eleven hundred metres up, above the Köprülü canyon, and that lofty position kept it independent for a long time. Selge struck its own coinage and grew rich on the trade in storax resin. And its theatre still stands today, right in the middle of a village.
highlights: As you wander, don't miss the theatre and the agora. Then seek out the temple of Zeus, and finish at the cisterns.
facts: Did you know? Selgian coins show a branch of the storax tree the city sold, and its resin was burned as incense across the ancient world. The city stood eleven hundred metres up, and that position kept it independent for a long time.
outro: This brings our tour of Selge to an end. Please leave the stones untouched, keep to the marked paths and carry water with you. Let these mountain stones keep their story for those who come after you. Enjoy your visit.
